insert.material: 1.5 mm frosted or milky translucent PETG

visible_seam_cap.description: A shallow translucent cap overlaps the deeper 0.35 mm-clearance insert body. The cap nearly reaches opaque-panel and neighboring-pane boundaries, closing the dark visual gaps while preserving assembly clearance below it.

mount.fastener: internal M2.5 through-bolt with two washers and one loose nyloc nut

ear_root_interfaces.description: Each ear-root region is one simplified three-plane insert: the TRI pane, synthetic bridge triangle, and the QUAD pane's largest outer triangle share edges in one solidified surface mesh. A redundant smaller coplanar triangle contained inside each QUAD source panel is deliberately omitted. One hook and one bolt retainer mount to well-separated hidden upper-head edges, so the ear remains independently removable. Mirrored relief preserves clearance around the unchanged Gate 5 M3 flange tabs.

review_notes: Normal source panels are combined only when they share complete mesh edges. Each explicit ear-root cluster becomes edge-connected through its synthetic bridge triangle.

The twelve connected centerline facets become one non-planar printed diffuser. Each TRI/bridge/QUAD ear-root region becomes one simplified three-plane insert, leaving seven printed translucent parts total.

Each insert has a shallow 0.05 mm-clearance visible seam cap over its 0.35 mm-clearance deeper fit body. This closes ordinary pane-to-shell and pane-to-pane visual gaps without making the entire insert a zero-clearance assembly fit.
Every insert seats behind the shell with a translucent overlap flange and thin black gasket, so it cannot fall through its exterior opening.
Fixed internal hooks carry one side of each insert. Internal M2.5 flange tabs retain the opposite side; both sit beneath the opaque shell border rather than behind the illuminated aperture.

TRI027, its synthetic bridge, and the outer plane of QUAD021 form one right ear-root insert; TRI055, its bridge, and the outer plane of QUAD035 form the mirrored left insert. Redundant contained coplanar QUAD faces are omitted. Each cluster is generated as one three-plane edge-connected surface, solidified once, retained at two hidden upper-head edges, and uses a 25 mm top-only relief plus 10 mm localized top-side setbacks around the recessed structural M3 ear flange pair. The long front and rear pane boundaries remain in contact with the head.
The central insert uses two hooks on upper-head interfaces and two M2.5 retainers on lower-face interfaces. Each isolated insert uses one hook and one retainer.
LED cassettes and individual light-blocking chambers remain a later gate; Gate 7 only creates printable diffusers and their mechanical attachment.
